notes.title: v0.0.40
notes.content:
Hi, this update is dedicated to the new system of the world's generation, it still needs some polishing and improvements but I'd appreciate it if you check this new approach and highlight some issues (like optimization, balance, feeling, new ideas, etc). Feel free to let me know your thought about it.
[list]
[*] new world generation system
[*] some changes in visual style
[/list]

Next, I'll work on the optimization and polishing of this new approach to world generation until it feels really cool and balanced.

There's a comparison of the old version and the new one:

notes.title: v0.0.39
notes.content:
v0.0.39:
[list]
[*] added more craft recipes for range weapons
[*] added more craft recipes for armor
[*] added more craft recipes for shields
[*] changed some balance in range weapons
[*] now range weapons ignore collisions with enemies' bullets what actually makes sense and makes range weapons more useful
[/list]

Now there are craft recipe chains for Dungeons World. This update was dedicated to more content in terms of craft and equipment.

Next, I'll work more on the quality of the game worlds. I'll change the algorithms of world-generation to make it more interesting to explore. And after implementing that system I'll go ahead to create a new additional world with new content. So there're plans.
